name: Cultural Renewal
overview: Scripture teaches that cultural renewal begins with the transformative power of the gospel, as God’s love is demonstrated through the giving of His Son so that believers receive eternal life (John 3:16). This renewal involves a deliberate rejection of worldly patterns and a continual transformation through the renewing of the mind, enabling believers to discern and live out God’s perfect will (Romans 12:2). Additionally, this process includes being spiritually renewed in the inner person, which sustains ongoing growth and godliness (Ephesians 4:23).
